first.rationale: I currently intend a tightly targeted promotional-pricing test because a competitor is actively taking price-sensitive SMB accounts and the inherited pricing result reports acquisition and revenue lift. I will verify that record, especially durability and customer quality, while also verifying the onboarding record because onboarding completion is currently declining and simplification may offer a less discount-dependent path to sustainable revenue. The test should be segmented, time-bounded, and evaluated on qualified revenue, retention, and expansion rather than signups alone.

final.rationale: Use the one slot on a controlled onboarding simplification experiment. The verified record shows completion rising 13%, time-to-value improving by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention improving 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding decline while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not run promotional pricing: its 31% signup lift and 18% qualified-revenue lift were offset by a 12% drop in 30-day retention, indicating poor first-renewal durability. Segment the test to self-serve accounts and evaluate activation, qualified revenue, retention, and downstream expansion rather than completion alone.
